risks.title: Currency Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The majority of sales and manufacturing occur outside the United States, with substantial exposure to international markets, particularly in Asia-Pacific (China, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan). Fluctuations in exchange rates relative to the U.S. dollar may materially impact revenue and profitability

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: Evolving market with competing players in mixed-signal semiconductors, requiring continuous innovation to maintain leadership position

risks.title: Customer Demand Dependency
risks.score_rationale: Dependence on OEM customer demand, particularly in mobile devices, PCs, smart home, and automotive sectors. End of mobile shipments contributed to a 9% decline in Mobile revenue

risks.title: Acquisition Integration Risks
risks.score_rationale: Risks related to the integration of the Broadcom acquisition (Wi-Fi assets and non-exclusive licenses). This acquisition contributes +53% to Core IoT revenue but generates additional amortization expenses

risks.title: International Regulatory and Trade Risks
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to international regulations, including evolving customs tariffs (U.S./China). Actively monitored, but current tariff exposure remains limited based on current import/export practices

risks.title: Debt Management
risks.score_rationale: Successful refinancing of the $582 million Term Loan through a $450 million convertible bond. Net debt reduced from $972.9 million (2024) to $834.8 million (2025). Executed a capped call transaction to mitigate dilution

risks.title: Technology Investments and R&D
risks.score_rationale: Reliance on technological innovation to remain competitive in Edge AI, wireless connectivity, and user interfaces. R&D investments increased by 3.1% to $346.8 million, representing 32.3% of revenue

ai_positioning.summary: Synaptics positions AI as a central element of its strategy. The company emphasizes Edge AI solutions through its Synaptics Astra platform, in collaboration with Google for next-generation Edge AI devices. Native AI solutions are integrated into processors, wireless connectivity, and user interfaces.
